patch_resolves_note: The bundled arvo_11000 patch.diff only changes kerx handling and does not touch the witnessed morx insertion path. The authoritative fixed-side oracle is the prebuilt -fix image, whose source contains the later end-of-text guard from HarfBuzz commit 1c76c8f6ff7877e486f6e94d04b2dc65348b26d5.

edges.description: The copied pseudo-glyph stays at the same logical output slot: `copy_glyph()` writes it at `out_info[out_len]`, and after `move_to(end + count)` the surviving copied record is still the slot named by `end`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records copied_record_ptr=19 at copy_tail_glyph and preserve_copy.

edges.description: That preserved slot later reappears as the noncontextual loop index `i`, which means swap_buffers published the copied pseudo-glyph into the live buffer consumed by the later subtable.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records preserve_copy.copied_record_ptr == noncontextual_lookup.glyph_record_ptr for the copied pseudo-glyph slot.

edges.description: The noncontextual subtable forwards that same published pseudo-glyph codepoint unchanged into LookupFormat0::get_value as `glyph_id`, where the sanitizer reports the first executed use of the uninitialized scalar.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records the same lookup_key value at noncontextual_lookup and lookup_sink.

root_cause_criterion.description: The current-insert copy branch must require a live current glyph in addition to `!before`; otherwise the end-of-text entry still executes copy_glyph()/skip_glyph() on `info[len]`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: At the vulnerable end-of-text root event, the actual copy condition is 1 (`!before`) while the required guarded condition is 0 (`buffer->idx < buffer->len && !before`). In the fixed image the same site reports 0 == 0, confirming the missing conjunct has been restored at the root-cause line.
